component: Graph fake-server continuation and size assertions

quotes.text: "the correct message sizes should have been reported"

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The new fake continuation links copy the incoming query and replace prior skip/delta tokens, retaining the requested extended-property expansion on later pages. The mock recognizes a particular expansion substring and reports toMessageString().length. The new size assertions use that same string-length measure, so their direct result is mock size-array equality, not UTF-8 byte accuracy for non-ASCII messages or support for every valid OData expression.
title: The Graph size mock preserves expansion queries across delta links
